capabilities: Convert text matching vault file names into wiki links on save or by command
Batch-format the entire vault or only selected text
Resolve shorthand links to namespaced paths using proximity-based matching and aliases
Format GitHub, Jira, and Linear URLs and replace bare URLs with page-title Markdown links
Copy file or selection content with wiki links stripped
extras: URL title replacement fetches page titles over the network (cached to minimize requests). The README notes it does not run Prettier or Linter, and provides troubleshooting and frontmatter opt-out documentation.
problem: Obsidian requires manually typing wiki links to connect notes, so large vaults accumulate unlinked text that matches existing file names.

relations.evidence: When Bullet is enabled, Automatic Linker skips its own automatic formatting on save

summary: Link-conversion plugin that turns text matching vault file names into wiki links as you save or run a command, and formats raw URLs into readable Markdown links.
